title: Arkret Agent Membership Cascade
description: Closed binding and durable cleanup state for Agent Realm membership. Effective membership is the AND of the Agent member cell, the exact controller membership generation, Agent lifecycle and provision/accountability validity. Canonical Agent leave transitions are always caller-signed; a service never synthesizes them.

membership_lifecycle_cause.description: Closed audit-only lifecycle cause. It never supplies authorization or proves reducer provenance.

controller_membership_generation_ref.description: Exact controller ak.member.state join Event that establishes the bound membership generation. It must already be accepted, except that the complete controller-Agent Direct Conversation founding unit explicitly references its preceding staged founder join and activates all four Events atomically. A later rejoin has another Event ID and never revives this binding.

controller_terminal_event_ref.description: Required only on an explicit controller-membership-ended cleanup Event. It identifies the accepted terminal controller transition whose pre-state determines the exact Agent set and one-shot cascade authority.

expected_agent_ids.description: Exact set of active controlled Agent ActorIds frozen from terminal pre-state, sorted by unsigned UTF-8 bytes of each RFC 8785 JCS ActorId. Every element MUST identify an Agent in that pre-state; a bare principal DID or a different Station is not the same member.

cleanup_intent_digest.description: sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical record fields through expected_agent_ids. It is the durable idempotency key for emergency cleanup.

cleanup_due_at.description: Governance alert deadline only. Crossing it changes pending to overdue but never restores controller or Agent authority.
